namespace Nl2LeanExpected

theorem even_iff_even_three_mul (n : ℤ) : Even n ↔ Even (3 * n) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem even_iff_even_three_mul (n : ℤ) : Even n ↔ Even (3 * n) :=
by
  split
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h

  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
    rw [mul_one, hk, mul_one]
    exact even_of_add_one_even _
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.even_iff_even_three_mul = Nl2LeanCandidate.even_iff_even_three_mul := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
